captured_by.description: Who captured it: an actor of the audit trail.

checks.description: What the platform found in the reading: arithmetic, dates, the GST number's form, the IRAS tax-invoice particulars it lacks.

confidence.description: Each field's confidence after the platform's checks, which only ever lower it.

draft.description: The draft a person made of it.

duplicate_of.description: The capture of the same file, for a duplicate.

file_name.description: As sent: data, never a path.

kind.description: What the reading says it is.

low_confidence.description: The fields shown that the model or a check doubts, to highlight for the person who reviews the draft.

media_type.description: Its type, decided from its content.

message_id.description: The accepted mail it came from.

note.description: Why it failed, in plain words.
examples: Only a PDF or a photo can be read: type the bill in

nric_flagged.description: true when its text shows an NRIC or FIN in full (FR-DOC-09): it is never sent to a model, so it is not read; mask it and capture it again, or type the bill in.

own.description: true when it arrived at the caller's own email-in address: only they see it.

reading.description: What the model read, each field with its confidence; absent until it is read.

reading_is.description: Always the model's reading: untrusted data to check against the document, never a figure Fyniq decided.

readings.description: How many times it was read.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file as stored, in hexadecimal.

status.description: received: kept, not read yet; reading: the model is reading it; read: its reading is ready to check; duplicate: the same file is in the inbox already; drafted: a person made a draft of it; dismissed: no draft will be made; failed: it could not be read, as note says.

supplier.description: The supplier contact the reading's supplier matches, when one does.

version.description: Its version; it makes the ETag.
